answer: Three conductors judge a live audition, and each stakes his chair on the verdict. A velvet recording cannot audition: the panel listens at the oasis of every phrase for the breath a recording flattens, and a fake fails the first bar. Staging a false audition costs a forger 14,000 in bribes to conductors who would lose their posts, and the jade mark on the audition sheet follows the player, so a failed name cannot re-audition under a new one.
